assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons are repository provisional constraints and are used only for temporary generation, visualization, and self-check.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, and topology metrics must be recalculated when official CAD/GIS/PDF boundary data is cleared.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, FAR, height, density, setbacks, and engineering constraints are not included in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: The package records concept proposals and unknown statutory metrics without converting them into approval or implementation claims.

assumptions.statement: Land use, building footprints, public-space, green-space, service-wing, memory-node, and phasing layers are AI-generated concept proposals inside the provisional site.
assumptions.impact: They are reviewable design evidence but not existing-condition surveys, parcel decisions, demolition decisions, or construction commitments.

assumptions.statement: Road features are conceptual centerlines and slow-mobility/service links, not official road redlines or engineering alignments.
assumptions.impact: Road area and right-of-way metrics remain unknown until official redline/cross-section data is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Scenario cards, industry validation scenarios, global AI events, and developer-community operations are proposed as reversible pilot mechanisms with human review gates.
assumptions.impact: They should be tested through public-interest, privacy, accessibility, and operational review before any real service launch.

assumptions.statement: Scenario concepts do not require personal data, non-public government data, vendor lock-in, or automated irreversible decisions.
assumptions.impact: Each scenario must preserve opt-in participation, minimization, explainability, and human appeal/review routes.

assumptions.statement: External benchmark sources are used only for mechanism inspiration and comparison vocabulary.
assumptions.impact: They do not imply endorsement, local approval, suitability, certification, or reuse permission for visual assets.
